faq.question: Can Birdcast create videos for Dubai real estate brokers?
faq.answer: Yes. Brokers can record market commentary, buyer advice, personal brand videos, area insights and property-focused explainers.

faq.question: Can developers record launch or campaign content?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support developer interviews, project stories, leadership videos and campaign material.

faq.question: Can one real estate session create several clips?
faq.answer: Yes. A planned session can produce multiple short clips, one longer interview or a mix of both.

faq.question: Is this only for studio content?
faq.answer: This page focuses on studio-led real estate video, but WhatsApp is best if the project needs a broader production discussion.

faq.question: What should a broker send before recording?
faq.answer: Send the topic, target audience, preferred platforms, any key market points and examples of content you like.
